name: aurora-pg-parameter-advisor
description: Scans Aurora PostgreSQL cluster parameter groups for known misconfiguration - memory-hungry parameters on small instances (shared_buffers, work_mem, maintenance_work_mem exceeding capacity), wal_level=logical without logical replication use, max_connections too high for instance memory, and extension conflicts during upgrades - compares against best-practice baselines using CloudWatch memory and connection signals, and produces a ranked, read-only-safe list of safe parameter changes. Read-only. Recommends a custom Postgres MCP (pg_settings and Performance Insights) and the AWS Documentation MCP as augmentation. This is Aurora-PostgreSQL-specific tuning, not generic parameter-group drift.

trigger.description: Runs weekly on SAT at 22:00 UTC
